Wikipedia: Blake’s opposition to the Enlightenment, embodied in Newton

work.text: Newton is a monotype by the English poet, painter and printmaker William Blake first completed in 1795, but reworked and reprinted in 1805. It is one of the 12 "Large Colour Prints" or "Large Colour Printed Drawings" created between 1795 and 1805

Delicate fibrous growths of moss and lichen, strange many-petalled flowers, stains of metal and damp upon grey rock surfaces are wrought with a minuteness beyond the reach of the most ardent Pre-Raphaelite

moment.text: Newton's theory of optics was especially offensive to Blake, who made a clear distinction between the vision of the "vegetative eye" and spiritual vision.
Newton was incorporated into Blake's infernal trinity along with the philosophers Francis Bacon and John Locke.

matters.text: 'Tis fourfold in my supreme delight, / And threefold in soft Beulah's night, / And twofold Always. May God us keep / From Single vision, & Newton's sleep!
